verdict.rationale: Each skill ships a SKILL.md with a clear description of what it does and explicit 'use when' triggers (e.g., grilling skill 'Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking', setup skill 'Run once before first use of the other engineering skills'), and the aihero.dev catalog gives one-line purpose descriptions for all 25 skills plus a dedicated skill to pick the right one for a situation. This directly supports predicting new agent behavior before invocation.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that these descriptions reliably predict actual agent behavior in practice, and community commentary raises concerns about verbosity/utility of the prose rather than confirming clarity.
